title: Depth-First Search
question: Visit a graph using iterative depth-first search.
code:
graph = {'A': ['B', 'C'], 'B': ['D'], 'C': ['E'], 'D': [], 'E': []}
stack = ['A']
seen = set()
order = []
while stack:
    node = stack.pop()
    if node in seen: continue
    seen.add(node); order.append(node)
    stack.extend(reversed(graph[node]))
print(*order)
explanation: A stack explores the most recently added node first.
